text:
Photo is right next to my hooch. this is my Thompson. Gagne got me this. He went into the special forces armory, signed it out and handed it to me. He was in charge of the armory.
the building in the background I believe is our units armory. to the right of it offscreen would be EM Club (Enlisted Men's Club) where they had beer for 4 cents and goochie goochie girls. They were all girls from the Philippines mostly. A lot of them spoke english
